fine_lines.title: person vs people
fine_lines.explanation_ar: person للمفرد (شخص واحد)، و people للجمع (أشخاص). لا نقول peoples بمعنى أشخاص.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Person" is one; "people" is the plural. Use people for more than one.

examples.sentence: There are many people in the market.

fine_lines.title: house vs home
fine_lines.explanation_ar: house هو المبنى نفسه، و home هو المكان الذي تعيش فيه وتشعر بالانتماء له. ونقول go home بدون to.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A house is the building. Home is the place where you live and belong. We say "go home" with no "to".

fine_lines.title: kind vs sort
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان بمعنى «نوع» ويمكن استخدام أي منهما: what kind of / what sort of.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean "type". You can use either one.

examples.sentence: What kind of music do you like?
What sort of books do you read?

fine_lines.title: reason vs cause
fine_lines.explanation_ar: reason هو التفسير «لماذا» فعل شخص شيئاً، و cause هو الشيء الذي أدى إلى حدوث شيء (غالباً مشكلة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: A reason explains why someone did something. A cause is what made something happen, often a problem.

examples.sentence: Tell me the reason for your absence.
Rain was the cause of the delay.

fine_lines.title: price vs cost
fine_lines.explanation_ar: price هو المبلغ المكتوب على السلعة، و cost هو كم يكلفك الشيء بشكل عام (وقد تشمل مصاريف أخرى). وcost أيضاً فعل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: The price is the amount written on a thing you buy. Cost is how much you spend in general. "Cost" is also a verb.

examples.sentence: The cost of living is high here.

grammar.title: Countable and uncountable nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: الأسماء المعدودة نستطيع عدّها ولها جمع: a car, two cars. الأسماء غير المعدودة لا نعدّها ولا نضع معها a ولا نجمعها: money, information, food. نستخدم معها some / a lot of / much.
grammar.explanation_en: Countable nouns can be counted and have a plural: a car, two cars. Uncountable nouns cannot be counted. They have no "a" and no plural: money, information. Use some, much or a lot of with them.
examples: some money, a lot of information

grammar.title: Irregular plurals
grammar.explanation_ar: معظم الأسماء نجمعها بإضافة s. لكن بعض الأسماء الشائعة لها جمع خاص يجب حفظه: child → children، man → men، woman → women، person → people، life → lives، city → cities.
grammar.explanation_en: Most nouns add -s for the plural. Some common nouns have a special plural: child → children, man → men, woman → women, person → people, life → lives, city → cities.

grammar.title: a / an before nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: نضع a قبل الاسم المفرد الذي يبدأ بصوت ساكن (a car, a job)، و an قبل الاسم الذي يبدأ بصوت متحرك (an idea, an example). المهم هو الصوت وليس الحرف: an hour لأن h صامتة.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "a" before a singular noun that starts with a consonant sound (a car) and "an" before a vowel sound (an idea). The sound matters, not the letter: "an hour" because the h is silent.

questions.question: What is the plural of "child"?
questions.explanation_ar: جمع child هو children (جمع غير منتظم).

questions.question: "Do you have any ___?" Choose the correct word.

questions.explanation_en: "Information" is uncountable: no plural and no "an".
